description_en: Queries the performance monitoring information of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 查看云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的性能监控信息
name: DescribeHistoryMonitorValues

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query for historical monitoring data. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 查询历史监控开始时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query for historical monitoring data. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). You can query monitoring data from the last month, and the maximum query range cannot exceed 7 days
parameters.help_zh: 查询历史监控结束时间点，须晚于历史监控开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 支持查询最近1个月的监控数据，且最大查询范围不能超过7天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
[Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated and has a fixed value of `01m`.

The system automatically determines the query interval based on the start time and end time. For example, if the query time range is less than or equal to 10 minutes, the data aggregation frequency is 5s, and the query results are returned at a frequency of 5s.
The query results are aligned with the data aggregation frequency of the instance. If the StartTime you specify does not fall on a data aggregation time point, the first time point returned by the system is the nearest data aggregation time point. For example, if the StartTime you specify is 2022-01-20T12:01:48Z, the first time point returned by the system is 2022-01-20T12:01:45Z.
If the number of data shards of the instance is greater than or equal to 32, the minimum data aggregation frequency is 1 minute
parameters.help_zh:
本参数已废弃，固定取值为`01m`。

实际会根据查询的开始时间和结束时间自动决定查询的时间间隔。以查询时间范围小于等于10分钟为例，数据聚合频率为5s/次，查询结果会按照5s/次的频率返回。
查询结果会与实例的数据聚合频率对齐。若您传入的 StartTime 不在数据聚合时间点上，系统返回的首个时间点为最近的数据聚合时间点。例如您传入的 StartTime 为 2022-01-20T12:01:48Z，系统返回的首个时间点为 2022-01-20T12:01:45Z。
如果实例的数据分片数大于等于32，最小的数据聚合频率为1分钟/次
parameters.name: interval_for_history

parameters.help_en:
The monitoring metrics. To specify multiple monitoring metrics, separate them with commas (,). Using CpuUsage as an example:
Cluster or read/write splitting architecture:
    - To query the overall CPU usage of all data nodes (DB), specify CpuUsage$db.
To query the CPU usage of a single data node, specify CpuUsage and set the NodeId parameter to the DB node.

Standard architecture (primary/secondary): Specify CpuUsage.

For more monitoring metrics and detailed descriptions, see <props="china">MonitorKeys parameter description (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/redis/developer-reference/api-r-kvstore-2015-01-01-describehistorymonitorvalues-redis#monitorKeys-note)</props><props="intl">MonitorKeys parameter description (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/redis/developer-reference/api-r-kvstore-2015-01-01-describehistorymonitorvalues-redis#monitorKeys-note)</props>.
The default value is empty, which returns the UsedMemory and quotaMemory metrics.
To ensure query efficiency, when querying monitoring metrics for a single node, specify no more than 5 monitoring metrics per request. When querying aggregated monitoring metrics, specify no more than 1 monitoring metric per request
parameters.help_zh:
监控指标，如需传入多个监控指标，需使用英文逗号（,）分隔。以CpuUsage为例：
集群节点或读写分离架构：
    - 若您希望查询所有数据节点（DB）整体的CPU使用率，请传入CpuUsage$db。
若您希望查询单个数据节点的CPU使用率，请传入CpuUsage，同时在NodeId参数指定DB 节点。

标准架构（主备）：传入CpuUsage即可。

更多信息监控指标与详细说明，请参见下方的<props="china">MonitorKeys参数补充说明 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/redis/developer-reference/api-r-kvstore-2015-01-01-describehistorymonitorvalues-redis#monitorKeys-note)</props><props="intl">MonitorKeys参数补充说明 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/redis/developer-reference/api-r-kvstore-2015-01-01-describehistorymonitorvalues-redis#monitorKeys-note)</props>。
默认为空，将返回UsedMemory与quotaMemory指标。
为保障查询效率，查询单个节点的监控指标时，建议单次传入不超过5个监控指标；查询聚合监控指标时，建议单次不超过传入1个监控指标
parameters.name: monitor_keys

parameters.help_en:
The node ID in the instance. Specify this parameter to query the monitoring information of a specific node.

This parameter is available only when the instance architecture is read/write splitting or cluster.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html operation to query node IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例的中的节点ID。传入本参数可查询指定节点的监控信息。

当实例的架构为读写分离或集群架构时，本参数才可用。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473786.html接口查询节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
To query the metrics of read-only nodes in a cloud-native read/write splitting architecture instance, specify the specific NodeId and set this parameter to READONLY.
In other cases, you do not need to specify this parameter (or specify MASTER)
parameters.help_zh:
若希望查询云原生版读写分离架构实例中只读节点的指标，您在传入具体NodeId的同时，还需要在本参数传入READONLY。
其余情况请无需传入（或传入MASTER）
parameters.name: node_role

MonitorHistory.description_en:
The monitoring information returned in JSON format. For more information, see [Monitoring parameter description]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122091.html）.

To improve data transmission efficiency, only non-zero monitoring data is returned. All other monitoring data that is not displayed has a default value of 0
MonitorHistory.description_zh:
以JSON格式返回的监控信息，更多信息，请参见[监控参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122091.html）。

为提高数据传输效率，只有非0的监控数据才会返回，其余未显示的监控数据均为默认值0
